title: Underwriting Bulletin: SR-22 and FR-44 Filings on a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy
content:
Holding a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing (SR-22 or FR-44) changes what a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy may do.

## The financial-responsibility indicator

The indicator on the policy is switched on when an SR-22 or FR-44 filing is requested on the policy. It is switched off only when no filing on the policy remains requested, filed, accepted or in the state where cancellation has been notified.

## Restrictions while a filing is held

1. **Package.** While the indicator is on, the policy may be only on a package that may carry a filing. A policy holding a filing cannot be moved to a package that may not carry one.
2. **Requesting a filing.** A filing can be requested only on a policy whose current package may carry a filing. This is read from the package recorded on that policy. On the package chart, Cardinal Auto Essential, Cardinal Auto Basic and Cardinal Auto Standard may carry a filing; Cardinal Auto Plus, Cardinal Auto Preferred and Cardinal Auto Premier may not.
3. **Filed driver and exclusion.** The driver named on a filing cannot be excluded while the filing is active; the exclusion of a filed driver is declined.
4. **Mutual exclusion.** A driver cannot be both excluded on the policy and the subject of a filing on it.

## Judgement table

| Situation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Filing requested on a Cardinal Auto Standard policy | May be requested (package may carry a filing) |
| Filing requested on a Cardinal Auto Plus policy | Cannot be requested |
| Policy with an accepted filing asks to move from Cardinal Auto Standard to Cardinal Auto Plus | Cannot be moved |
| Exclusion requested for the driver named on an active filing | Declined |
| Last filing on the policy cancelled and no other filing requested, filed, accepted or cancel-notified | Indicator switched off |
